verdict.rationale: Unity's Player command-line docs describe a headless mode in which the application displays nothing and accepts no user input, so game logic can run on servers without rendering. Build profiles and multiplayer packages back this up as part of a server-oriented workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated-server build target or profile, details on stripping rendering from server builds, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless server deployments.
